author: root
source_passages: Section3.2, physicalpages6–7, dihedral centralizer degree reductions.
claims: Commuting group of a transitive permutation group is semiregular.
A core-free subgroup K of semiregular D gives a faithful representation of its whole centralizer on b[D:K] points.
Transitivity and all marked subgroup intersections are preserved.
A commuting dihedral group gives degree halving, and the retained rank theorem gives the stated rank obstruction.
priority: Standard centralizer theory and a uniform formulation of the existing source argument; no historical originality claim.
